params.name: request.classDescriptionId

params.name: request.endClassDateTime
params.description: Filters the results to class descriptions for scheduled classes that happen before the given date and time.

params.name: request.includeInactive
params.description: Includes inactive class descriptions, defaulting to true. When set to false, it filters out inactive class descriptions.

params.name: request.limit
params.description: Number of results to include, defaults to 100

params.description: Filters results to classes descriptions for schedule classes as the given location.

params.name: request.offset
params.description: Page offset, defaults to 0.

params.name: request.programIds
params.description: A list of requested program IDs.

params.name: request.staffId
params.description: Filters results to class descriptions for scheduled classes taught by the given staff member.

params.name: request.startClassDateTime
params.description: Filters the results to class descriptions for scheduled classes that happen on or after the given date and time.

items.docs: To find class descriptions associated with **scheduled classes**, pass `StaffId`, `StartClassDateTime`, `EndClassDateTime`, or `LocationId` in the request.

params.description:
When `true`, canceled classes are removed from the response.

Default: **false**

params.description: When included in the request, only records modified on or after the `LastModifiedDate` specified are included in the response.

params.name: request.schedulingWindow
params.description:
When `true`, classes outside scheduling window are removed from the response.
When `false`, classes are included in the response, regardless of the scheduling window.
Default: **false**

params.description: A list of semester IDs on which to base the search.

params.name: request.sessionTypeIds
params.description: A list of session type IDs on which to base the search.

params.name: request.staffIds
params.description: The requested IDs of the teaching staff members.

params.name: request.startDateTime
params.description: The requested start date for filtering. This also determines what you will see for the ‘BookingWindow’ StartDateTime in the response. For example, if you pass a StartDateTime that is on OR before the BookingWindow ‘Open’ days of the class, you will retrieve the actual ‘StartDateTime’ for the Booking Window. If you pass a StartDateTime that is after the BookingWindow ‘date’, then you will receive results based on that start date. NOTE: ClassDate does not take Class Time into consideration.

params.name: request.uniqueClientId
params.description: The unique ID of the client who is viewing this class list. Based on identity, the client may be able to see additional information, such as membership specials. Note: you need to provide the 'UniqueClientId' OR the 'ClientId'. If both are provided, the 'UniqueClientId' takes precedence.
